text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the way back from an outing with Still 
in Love, we stopped by a park—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Oh dear... That is—

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text: Waaah...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Don't worry. I will definitely find it.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Tact-san... What happened to that little 
one?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Still-senpai. Um... from what I heard, 
your pet ferret ran away.

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text:
*Hic*... Ferret-chan... The cage opened 
up... *hic*.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: My... That is concerning, isn't it...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I hear it hasn't been long since they ran 
off, so they should still be in the park. 
I'll go look around for a bit.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Um, in that case... may I help out as 
well?
choice_data_list:
The more hands the better, so I'll help 
too.

The more hands the better, so I'll help 
too.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. In that case, I'll leave that 
side to you upperclassmen.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Ferre-chan... Where are you~?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...! Trainer-san. Over there, behind the 
trash can...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking in the direction Still in Love 
pointed, a ferret popped its head out. 
Approaching quietly...
choice_data_list: C'mere... Ch-ch-ch-ch-ch.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Ah, deep in the bushes...
choice_data_list: Damn it, she got away...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, we kept searching for the 
ferret, but—even when it showed itself, it 
would immediately scurry off and hide in 
the bushes...
choice_data_list: She's really on her guard.
She's really on her guard.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
You're right... Ferrets are quite 
sensitive to sounds and scents, too...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just chasing after them like this won't 
get us anywhere. We'd better come up with 
a plan.
choice_data_list:
If chasing doesn't work, how about setting 
a trap?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
In that case, let's put food in the cage 
and set it up like a box trap. One of us 
will chase and herd her, and the other 
will close the door.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Could you leave the guiding role to me? I 
have some experience with drive hunting."
choice_data_list:
Then let's lie in ambush and close the 
door on them.

Then let's lie in ambush and shut the 
door.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes...!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...This is the spot, then. The ambush 
point...
choice_data_list: !—...Here it comes!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Lured by Daring Tact, the ferret showed 
itself. Perhaps noticing the food, it 
twitches its nose and approaches the cage.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I peered right into the cage... but the 
ferret didn't go inside, timidly keeping 
its distance.
choice_data_list: Kuh, their guard is up...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
But... she looks like she's really 
hungry... In that case...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Holding the food in her hand, Still in 
Love slowly approached the ferret.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
(So as not to startle them... Softly... 
quietly...)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
(...Yes. All that's here... is your... 
bait...)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
(So... don't worry... Please take your 
time... and enjoy your meal...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When Still in Love placed the food in 
front of it, the ferret soon began to eat 
peacefully. Almost as if “nothing” was 
there at all.
choice_data_list: (Wow, she hasn't even noticed Still...!)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"...I've caught it. Trainer, please put 
this little one in the cage..."
choice_data_list: Leave it to me!

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Big Sisters!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Cradling the ferret cage, the young girl 
waved at us as she headed home.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
I'm so glad we were able to safely... 
return it to its owner.
choice_data_list: Yeah, you're right.
Yeah, that's true.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Still, Still-senpai was amazing. Getting 
right up in front of that wary ferret's 
eyes like that..."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Even among seasoned mountain hunters, very 
few can erase their presence so 
thoroughly. I truly have so much to learn 
from them!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
N-No, not at all... It's really not that 
big of a deal...
choice_data_list:
You really were amazing, so you should be 
proud of yourself.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Is that... so...? Um... it feels a little 
ticklish, I suppose...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
To me, blending into the background was 
always the norm, so...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
(So nobody sees the unladylike 'me,' and 
so I don't get in anyone's way...)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
(Acting like "I don't exist"... I kept 
telling myself that's how I should be—)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
(To think... the day would come where I 
could be proud of that...)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
“—I'm... somehow really happy. ...And a 
little surprised.”
choice_data_list: Your modesty is a true virtue.
Your modesty is truly a virtue.

That strategy really brought out both your 
strengths and Tact's!

That strategy really brought out the best 
in both you and Tact!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
“—I'm... somehow really happy. ...And a 
little surprised.”
choice_data_list: Your modesty is a true virtue.
Your modesty is truly a virtue.

That strategy really brought out both your 
strengths and Tact's!

That strategy really brought out the best 
in both you and Tact!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Disciplining herself so as not to cause 
trouble for anyone. That was undeniably 
the fruit of her hard work, and—
choice_data_list: I'm so proud of you.
I'm so proud of you just the way you are

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"...Pride? No... It is not something so 
grand..."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Still... hearing you say that... ...makes 
me feel a little touched...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Tact-san's navigation... it was as 
if she could sense everything around her. 
It was truly reassuring.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Perhaps the two of us make a pretty 
good hunting team.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Chuckle... That's true.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Still in Love shared a quiet smile with 
Daring Tact.
